weapons.name: Mk23 Pistol
weapons.source_note: HK Mark 23 Operator's Manual, specification table: "Twist Length" "378 mm (14.88 in.)". HK states the .45 ACP Mark 23 barrel twist directly in millimetres as 378 mm per turn.

weapons.name: MP7 Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: HK Product Catalog 2009, MP7A1 description: "7-inch cold-hammer forged barrel with right hand twist rifling (1 turn in 6.3 inches)". A 1 turn in 6.3 inch twist = 6.3 x 25.4 = 160.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Big Boy .44 Mag lever action, 20" octagonal barrel
weapons.source_note: Henry H6 Big Boy product page, model H006G "H6 Big Boy Rifle .44 Magnum/.44 Spl": "Barrel Length 20" ... Rate of Twist 1:20". A 1 turn in 20 inch twist = 20 x 25.4 = 508.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: H001 .22 LR classic lever action, 18.5" barrel
weapons.source_note: Henry H1 Classic product page, model H001-22 "H1 Classic Rifle .22 S/L/LR": "Barrel Length 18.5" ... Rate of Twist 1:16". A 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: X Model .44 Mag black synthetic lever, 17.4" barrel, M-Lok forend
weapons.source_note: Henry X Model product page, model H012X "H12 X Model .44 Magnum/.44 Spl": "Barrel Length 17.4" ... Rate of Twist 1:20". A 1 turn in 20 inch twist = 20 x 25.4 = 508.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: 4095 blowback
weapons.source_note: Hi-Point Carbine Instruction Manual, Model 4095 specification block: "Caliber: .40 S&W ... Rifling: 7RH(1in10" Twist)". States a 7-groove right-hand 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 10 x 25.4 = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: SVD Dragunov Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: TM 8370-50097-OR/15, "Table 1. SVD Sniper Rifle Characteristics": "Rifling  1 turn in 10 inches, right-hand twist". A 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 10 x 25.4 = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CP33 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: KelTec CP33 Owner's Manual, specifications table: "Rifling  1 in 14 in   1 in 356 mm". KelTec states the .22 LR CP33 twist as 1 turn in 14 inches (= 355.6 mm).

weapons.name: P17 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: KelTec P17 Owner's Manual, specifications table: "Rifling  1 in 14 in   1 in 356 mm". KelTec states the .22 LR P17 twist as 1 turn in 14 inches (= 355.6 mm).
